purpose: Conservative station-level tariff overlay policy for V9

evidence.public_station_directory_refresh_2026_09: Atlas Recharge public free-station directory currently lists numerous Kilowatt-operated 22 kW stations as free, including Almaz Mall Casablanca, Carrefour Socco Alto, Ibn Batouta Mall, Sela Gallery, Commune d'Agadir, Parking Inbiaat, TotalEnergies Relais Taourirt and Agora Park Taza.
evidence.user_observation_2026_09_01: Kilowatt charging is free across most of the network, with only a small number of paid cities/sites; useful first-party user evidence, but not sufficient by itself to assign a paid amount or to identify every exception.

modeling.site_brand: station-specific; may be enriched only from explicit native name/address tokens or station-specific corroboration
modeling.app_source_access_network: Kilowatt public web map/native app where applicable
modeling.tariff_channel: Kilowatt direct/public access unless a distinct roaming channel is explicitly evidenced
modeling.status_source: Kilowatt public web map/native source; independent from tariff evidence

v9_policy.free_tariff_application: Apply 0 MAD only when the current native station record can be matched to station-specific public free-access evidence.
v9_policy.paid_tariff_application: Apply a non-zero tariff only when the exact station/site and amount are explicitly evidenced by Kilowatt-native data, verified app observation or a sufficiently strong station-specific source.
v9_policy.unresolved_tariff_application: Keep tariff null for unmatched stations. A likely-free network behavior may be retained as diagnostic context but must not silently become a production 0 MAD tariff.
do_not_do: Do not infer free solely from a missing native tariff field.
Do not apply a blanket paid rule to Casablanca or Taza because current station-specific free evidence contradicts it.
Do not infer CPO from site_brand or tariff source.
Do not overwrite native status provenance with tariff evidence.

next_step: Generate a 43-row station-level overlay, report exactly which native stations match current free evidence, leave the residual unmatched stations unresolved, and validate the result as a read-only V9 artifact before any stable integration.
